thread:
elaine: Quick follow-up from the authz postmortem call. We saw a KV cache regression in auth-proxy where token TTLs were not revalidated after key-rollout, resulting in ~7m of stale-positive validations. We rolled back, purged caches, and rotated the key. Need clear owners for remediation and recurrence monitoring.
tom: I'll take ownership of telemetry and alerts. Plan: emit compact structured trace for each validation: {kid, validation_status, ttl_remaining_ms, svc}. Add a counter metric auth.stale_accepts. ETA 10d.
vikram: I'll build a simple cache-invalidation webhook and add HMAC-signed requests for auth. Proposal: POST /internal/v1/cache/invalidate {service,kid,scope}. Will support batch invalidation for multi-kid rotates. ETA 6d.
olga: I'll own the playbook updates and tabletop coordination. Will add steps: rollback, force cache purge, rotate keys, customer-notification (for Dedicated). Draft in 3d.
security-bot: Created ticket SEC-2043: "auth-proxy-kv-stale-validations". Linked tickets: SEC-2044 (telemetry + metric), SEC-2045 (cache webhook), SEC-2046 (playbook + alerts).
ci-bot: Note: deployment rollback completed at 09:17 UTC, cache purge job finished 09:26 UTC. Post-rollback checks show 0 stale_accepts after 09:28 UTC.
tom: For telemetry I'll keep payload minimal to avoid PII: kid, result(ACCEPT/REJECT/EXPIRED), latency_ms, env. Will add sampling config to avoid ingestion spikes.
vikram: Webhook auth: HMAC with rotating signing keys from KMS. Will include per-service allowlist. I'll provide a stub lambda and integration tests.
olga: Playbook: add an alert rule: auth.stale_accepts > 3 in 10m triggers P1 paging to infra + sec and runbook step to verify recent deploys/rollouts. I'll draft runbook in 48h.
elaine: Consolidated action list and rough dates (please ack):
- Telemetry + metric (owner: tom) -> 10d
- Cache invalidation webhook + tests (owner: vikram) -> 6d
- Playbook + alert rule (owner: olga) -> 48h
- Permissions inventory of services using long-lived tokens (owner: tom) -> 4d
- Add incident to monthly recurrence review (owner: elaine) -> today
- Tabletop rehearsal (owner: olga) -> schedule next week
tom: Ack. I'll also add a Grafana panel for auth.stale_accepts and link to a small dashboard for quick triage.
vikram: Ack. I'll include a dry-run mode in the webhook so ops can test invalidations without side-effects.
olga: Ack. I'll send invites for tabletop and tag product ops + Dedicated customer success for copies of the playbook snippet.
elaine: Two extra notes: 1) For Private installations, document the cache purge commands and the endpoint contract for customers. 2) Let's run a one-week audit script across services to detect tokens with >30d TTL and flag them.
tom: I'll script the TTL audit and produce CSV of service, owner, token_ttl_days. ETA 4d.
security-bot: SEC-2043 status: triaged -> in-progress. Linked PRs: none yet.
ci-bot: Reminder: automated weekly digest will surface this incident in the "authz patterns" section for the next 12 weeks.
elaine: Thanks team. I'll create a single tracking board and link all SEC tickets. If you finish earlier, update ticket status. :white_check_mark:
